payDisclosure.title: Before you pay — please read
payDisclosure.l1: Payment is made in person at the Darb office only. No payment is processed on this website, and we will never ask for card details or a transfer through the platform.
payDisclosure.l2: The service fee covers consultation, file preparation, submission and follow-up. It does not cover official fees (visa, universities, uni-assist, certifications), the blocked account, insurance or accommodation.
payDisclosure.l3: Admission and visa decisions rest with official bodies independent of Darb; no outcome can be guaranteed.
payDisclosure.l4: You may cancel in writing at any time; refunds are calculated after deducting work performed and official third-party fees already paid.
